summary: The generated Playwright tests compile and run without errors but have some weaknesses in selector robustness and assertion strength. The test titles do not reference their testCaseIds, and the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' appears hardcoded and static, limiting reusability. The navigation validation uses a regex but does not confirm page content. No asynchronous assertion lacks await. All generated test cases are covered except for the skipped TC-002, which is documented. The code is straightforward and maintainable but could be improved by parameterizing selectors and linking testCaseIds in the test titles.

issues.description: Test titles do not include corresponding testCaseIds, reducing traceability between manual and automated tests.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in each test title to improve traceability and documentation.

issues.description: Selectors use hardcoded data-test attributes like 'product-1', which reduces flexibility and reusability for other products.
issues.recommendation: Parameterize selectors to support multiple products or reference a configuration object for better reusability.

issues.description: Navigation assertion verifies URL pattern matching '/product/1' but does not assert page content to confirm correct product detail page.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions on page content or elements unique to the product detail page to strengthen validation.

recommendations: Incorporate testCaseIds in test titles for mapping manual and automated tests.
Refactor selectors to improve flexibility and support multiple product identities.
Enhance navigation assertions by verifying dedicated page elements or headings on the product detail page.
